GATE UPDATE — Gerrit change 1395 is fully green and submittable.

- LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot): "[LLM-Review: PASS] rebar code review passed.
  1 advisory finding(s) (non-blocking)." No inline comments were left.
- Verified +1 (rebar CI bot): SUCCESS —
  https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30959819219
- unresolved_comment_count: 0
- submittable: true

DELIBERATELY NOT SUBMITTED, and the ticket remains in_progress. Landing code on main is a
shared-system mutation, and this change touches files another parallel stream is actively
re-architecting (ticket 465d owns adapters/jira_datacenter/*, and a third stream owns
set_parent in _hierarchy.py). The epic coordinator asked to verify against the acceptance
criteria first, so the Submit and the ticket close are theirs to make rather than mine.

Acceptance-criteria status for that review (all four met, evidence in the previous comment):
- _paged_search raises a dedicated stall error when startAt does not advance — YES
  (BackendPaginationStallError, in core so fetcher can name it).
- Fail-open handling does not swallow it — YES, at all FOUR sites (get_parent_map plus the
  three fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers). Note this is broader than the AC as originally
  written, which anticipated only the transport-side handler; plan review caught the other
  three and a transport-only fix would not have resolved the report.
- Held-out test proves termination within 2 calls — YES (26 calls -> exactly 2, asserted).
- Existing behaviour for well-behaved servers unchanged — YES (250/250 through all three
  whole-project readers; get_parent_map still returns {} for ordinary failures; full unit
  suite 8107 passed).

Worktree /Users/joeoakhart/18a4-stall retained until the change lands.
